text: INT - HOTEL ROOM – NIGHT1 1
SOPHIA LAWRENCE (20s, visibly drunk but beautiful, resilient) stumbles into the room, slams the door shut, and locks it. BAM! BAM! Someone pounds on the door.
Open up, you little brat! Don’t make this hard!
Tell that old hag she can forget about drugging me and shipping me off to marry that creep Leo!
Excuse me? What are you doing in my room?! Sophia spins around. ALEX CHRISTOPHER (late 20s, sharp, eyes unreadable) stands there—towel hanging low on his hips. She blinks. Her brain short-circuits.
Wow…Abs.
That’s not an answer.
Sorry, I— (the alcohol hits, she sways, falling against him) Alex steadies her.
You okay?
Bad guys… trying to take me… BOOM! The door flies open. Alex yanks Sophia into his arms.
Get. Out.
The thug hesitates—then bails. Sophia tilts her head up, eyes hazy.
(smirking, finger tracing his jawline) My hero. Alex opens his mouth to say something— but she kisses him.
Do you even know who I am? Sophia grins, tipsy and flirty.
Mmm… a very, very hot guy.
She pulls him closer. Their fingers lace.
INT - HOTEL ROOM – MORNING2 2
Phone ringing. Loud. Relentless. Sophia grunts, grabs it.

Sophia! Get your ass up! You're having a date with the Christopher family member in an hour—DO NOT be late! Sophia slowly sits up. Her head pounds. She looks around, sees the bed. The sheets. The unfamiliar room-She remembers. Her eyes go wide.
(horrified, muttering to herself) Oh. My. God. Did I just have a one- night stand… with a complete stranger?!
The shower shuts off.
Shit! He’s coming out! What should I do?!
INT - HOTEL ROOM – MORNING - CONTINUOUS3 3
Bathroom door creaks open.

Alex steps out—towel slung low, body cut like sin. He scans the room. Bed-A mess. Sophia-Gone. On the table—a stack of hundred-dollar bills and a note, stamped with a red lipstick kiss. Alex picks it up. Reads.
Let’s pretend it never happened. No hard feelings-last night was magnificent. Phone rings. Alex answers, still staring at the note.
Yeah. I remember. The arranged date. I’ll be there.
INT - COFFEE SHOP – DAY4 4
Sophia sits at a trendy café, facing a mirror, fingers tracing the fake scar on her forehead.
Let’s see if Leo Christopher still wants to marry me now.
A chair scrapes loudly. LEO CHRISTOPHER (Late 20s, entitled, overdressed, exudes arrogance) drops into the seat across from her. No greeting. Just a disgusted sneer.
You’re Sophia Lawrence? Oh, God. That scar is hideous. Sophia smirks, unbothered.
Same to you. You look worse than your profile pic. Like… a warthog with a trust fund. Leo’s smirk vanishes.
You think I want this marriage? Please.

If your dad and stepmom hadn’t begged me on their knees, I wouldn’t have even bothered showing up. Sophia’s smile doesn’t fade. But she notices something. Across the room—Alex. Relaxed. Amused. Sophia stands. Walks over. And—KISSES ALEX. Slow. Deliberate. Leo chokes on air. Sophia pulls back. Turns to Leo, eyes flashing.
Well, thank you for stopping by. But I’ve already picked my groom.
INT - COFFEE SHOP – DAY5 5
Leo scoffs, turning to Alex.
Is that so, Uncle? Sophia snaps her head toward Alex. Alex meets her gaze, unreadable. Then, a slow, effortless smile.
Leo, you’re embarrassing the family. Is that how a Christopher treats his future aunt?
My apologies, my dear uncle. After all—you’re crippled and she’s—visually challenging. A match made in heaven.
And you just lost a Beverly Hills mansion in Vegas. Maybe I should call your mother. Leo freezes. Face drains.
Sorry, Auntie. Nice meeting you. Gotta go! Leo bolts.
INT - COFFEE SHOP – DAY - CONTINUOUS6 6
Sophia and Alex lock eyes.
Last night. Heat. Hands. Skin. Sophia shakes it off.
No way. That guy knew what he was doing. There's no way he was a cripple! Alex studies her.
If it weren’t for that scar, she’d be a dead ringer for the woman from last night… Alex leans back, extending a hand.
We never properly introduced ourselves. Alex Christopher. Sophia takes his hand, firm shake.
Your future wife. Alex raises a brow.
That desperate?
More like destined, don’t you think? Alex chuckles.
Terms?
Contract marriage. One year. You help me reclaim my mother’s inheritance. Alex tilts his head, considering.
Fine. But I have a condition too.
INT - LAWRENCE MANSION – DAY7 7
Sophia pushes open the door. Her father, MR.LAWRENCE (50s, with authority) sits on the couch, seething.

Morning, Dad. You look thrilled to see me. CRASH! He hurls his glass at the floor. From the grand staircase, SALLY LAWRENCE (30s, overdressed, under-qualified stepmother) and AMBER LAWRENCE (20s, overdressed, mean, Sophia's step sister) strut in.
Sophia! Leo just called. He says... you’re ugly and uncultured!
Can’t blame him. If I were a guy, I’d puke just looking at you.
No husband, no inheritance… and now you’re embarrassing the family name? Be useful for once, Sophia—leave the house. Sophia smiles. Then grabs a teacup and hurls it straight at them.
This is my mother’s house. If anyone’s getting the hell out, it’s you—a bunch of freeloading parasites!
Glass shatters. Amber screeches, lunging. Sophia doesn’t flinch. She grabs a pair of scissors, yanks Amber’s collar, blade hovering at her neckline.
Mr.Lawrence rushes between them.
Sophia! Your mother and sister are right! Get the hell out! Sophia laughs. Loud. Dangerous. She reaches into her bag. Pulls out a document.
About that…
She unfolds the paper, waves it like a winning poker hand.
Mom left me fifty percent of Lawrence Corp.
The room falls dead silent.
So guess what, Daddy? That makes me the boss here.
INT - LAWRENCE MANSION – DAY8 8
No. That’s impossible! Leo said—
Who said Leo was my only option?
She whips out a marriage certificate.
Alex Christopher? Who the hell is that?
Oh. That Christopher. The crippled one. Useless. A total disgrace to his family.
Sophia tilts her head, smirking.
INT - EVEREST CAPITAL – DAY9 9
Alex stands at the window, sipping coffee, overlooking the city—no wheelchair in sight. William enters, dropping a folder onto the desk.
Boss, we finally have a lead on the accident from five years ago! Alex flips through the report, eyes narrowing.
Took long enough. The second I have proof, Victor’s finished.
You spent years faking an injury, had the whole family thinking you were worthless, while building an empire from the shadows as X? That’s not just revenge, boss. That’s art.
Blood for blood. No exceptions. William flips another page, frowns.
One problem—Victor’s guys wiped the surveillance footage. No trace left. Alex takes another sip of coffee, unfazed.
There’s always a trace.
He turns, finally meeting William’s gaze.
Tell me—ever heard of Lawrence Corp? William raises an eyebrow.
Yeah… tech empire, owns SkyNet, the only system that can restore deleted data. Alex lets the corner of his mouth lift.
And guess who just took over as CEO?
INT - LAWRENCE CORP – BOARDROOM – DAY10 10
Sophia stands at the head of the conference table, composed. She places a folder down.
Per my mother’s will, I’m officially stepping in as CEO of Lawrence Corp. Board members murmur.
Mr. Lawrence pushes back his chair, arms crossed.
Absolutely nonsense. Sophia has zero business experience. And frankly—that hideous scar on her face? Complete PR nightmare.
And let’s not forget—her husband is that useless cripple from the Christopher family. What exactly is he bringing to the table?
A few board members nod.
Sophia, the board has concerns about your leadership. There’s no proof you’re ready for this.
Unless... if you can land a contract with Everest Capital in three days, we’ll reconsider.
Consider it done.
EXT - LAWRENCE CORP – DAY11 11
Sophia steps out—right into Amber and two female colleagues.
Sophia, sweetie… Everest Capital is run by the most powerful man in the world—X. but the guy’s practically a ghost! What makes you think you have a shot at getting in the room with him?
Guess we'll have to find out.
Sophia, please. X doesn’t waste his time on nobodies!
Unless... you’re planning to spread your legs for him.
Oh, please. Like she’d even hesitate. She’s probably dreaming about it already—poor thing needs the attention! Sophia grabs Amber’s hair—yanks hard.
Are you fucking insane?! HONK! A sleek luxury car rolls up. The tinted window lowers. Alex sits inside—one arm draped lazily over the window frame.
Damn, baby… watching you fight for yourself like that? Kind of a turn-on. Sophia blinks. Amber and the others stand frozen.
EXT. LAWRENCE CORP – DAY12 12
Alex leans against his car, looking effortlessly cool. He holds out a bouquet to Sophia. She takes it, barely masking her surprise. Amber and her colleagues gawk.
Tell me I’m hallucinating. Did he just call her... baby?
There’s no way—no way—a guy like that would be interested in her! Amber shoves past them, eyes locked on Alex. She slowly crosses her arms under her chest, pushing her cleavage up,, smiling sweetly.
Not to sound rude or anything… but I just have to know—what do you see in her? Alex tilts his head, smirking.
Who should I be interested in then? You?
She’s married! Her poor crippled husband clearly isn’t enough for her, so now she’s playing you! Alex chuckles, shaking his head.
Huh. Well, if that’s the case… I don’t mind being played.
Oh, where are my manners? Alex, meet Ashely—my father’s illegitimate daughter. Alex gives her a once-over, unimpressed.
Ah. Now it makes sense. No class whatsoever. Come on, sweetheart. Let’s get out of here.
He opens the car door. Sophia slides in. Amber, shaking with fury, rushes to the car and pounds on the window.
You hideous bitch! Who the hell do you think you are?! Sophia slowly rolls down the window, unfazed.
I‘m the Bitch? Honey, the way you just threw yourself at my husband-that was embarrassing.
Oh, right. Forgot to introduce myself properly. Alex Christopher. Sophia’s husband. The cripple you were just talking about.
EXT. ALEX’S ESTATE – NIGHT13 13
A luxury car pulls up to an opulent mansion. Sophia steps out, eyes widening.
Damn. This place is magnificent! I thought you were the least favored son in the Christopher family? Alex smirks, effortlessly composed, reclining in his motorized wheelchair.
Lucky for you. For the next year, this is your home, too. Contractually, of course.
INT. ALEX’S ESTATE – DINING ROOM – NIGHT14 14
A lavish dining table is covered with a spread fit. Sophia stares, utterly thrown. Alex, wearing an apron, sets down a steak. He cuts a slice and slides the plate toward her.
Medium rare. Thought you might like it.
Okay… tell me you didn’t secretly hire a private chef just to impress me.
Glad you liked it. But trust me—cooking’s just the beginning.
He lifts his wine glass, voice turning a shade more serious.
To you… my wife. Sophia pauses, then smirks, lifting her glass.
To business partnerships. And… my contract husband.
They drink. Then—
(leaning back, tilting her head) So… what’s that one condition you mentioned?
Patience, sweetheart. You’ll know when it’s time.
INT. ALEX’S BATHROOM – NIGHT15 15
Steam billows through the air. Water runs down Alex’s chest. A soft knock. Then—the door cracks open.
Alex, just a heads up—I’m coming in. Alex’s eyes snap open. He turns toward the door, startled.
INT. ALEX’S BATHROOM – NIGHT16 16
The door swings open. Sophia steps in. Their eyes lock. Alex flashes his fake, businesslike smile.
Didn’t realize we were doing late- night visits, sweetheart. Shouldn’t you be in bed?
I was just thinking… bathing must be a little tricky for you. As your wife, I figured I should help.
Appreciated, but I got this. Sophia ignores him, rolling up her sleeves. Before he can stop her, she grabs the shower head, ready for action.
Wait… you shower in the wheelchair?
It’s waterproof. Top of the line.
Well… alright then.
She awkwardly starts rinsing his back. As the water trickles down, she suddenly stops—Alex is still wearing his pants.
So… you bathe with pants on?
Baby, I know we are married, but stripping for you this soon? Feels a little… inappropriate. Don’t you think?
Come on, don’t be shy-unless you plan on dry-cleaning your legs. Alex immediately wheels back.
Yeah—no, we’re not doing that. Sophia steps forward, unfazed.

Relax. I’m just being helpful. As she leans in, her foot suddenly slips on the wet tile. She yelps—losing balance. Alex catches her mid-fall—arms instinctively wrapping around her waist. Sophia is now in his lap, face inches from his. Suddenly, the “scar” on her face wipes away.
Your...your face—!
INT. ALEX’S BATHROOM – NIGHT17 17
Sophia touches her face instinctively.
Oh, hell.
She whirls to the mirror—her skin is flawless. Not a trace of the fake scar. Alex leans in slightly, his fingers brush against her cheek.
So this is the real you… FLASHBACK – INT. HOTEL ROOM – NIGHT (Episode 1)
A darkened room. Tangled sheets. Heated kisses.
Alex stares, his thumb lightly trailing her cheek.
That night...It was you. Sophia snaps out of it, pulling back.

I wasn’t trying to fool you! My stepmother and stepsister hated me growing up—tried to ruin me at every turn. This was the only way to survive. Alex’s thumb brushes against her cheek, his touch slow, deliberate. His gaze locks onto hers—intense.
Shhh-You don’t have to explain. I get it. Sophia narrows her eyes, suspicious.
Okay....why are you still looking at me like this? This is starting to feel weird. Alex’s lips curl into a smirk.

Just thinking… we’re already drenched. You still offering to help me with my bath? Sophia’s eyes flick to his throat—his collarbone—his very bare chest. CLOSE-UP: Alex’s abs. Water dripping down his toned body. Sophia jolts back, laughing awkwardly, retreating toward the door.
Oh wow, look at the time—I totally forgot I have… things to do.
She slams the door shut behind her.
INT. CHRISTOPHER GROUP OFFICE – DAY18 18
Alex rolls inside, impossibly relaxed. Across from him, MR. CHRISTOPHER (mid-60s, stone-faced, expensive suit) holds a marriage certificate.
Who the hell gave you permission to get married? THWAP! A stack of papers flies straight at Alex’s head.
Sophia, cornered, colliding into a man in a deep blue tie.
…You!
INT. CHRISTOPHER GROUP OFFICE – DAY19 19
Alex bends down, picking up the scattered papers off the floor.
It’s my marriage. My life. I don’t need your approval.
Mr. Christopher pushes his reading glasses up, brow furrowing.
You—! Ever since that accident, you’ve changed. You’ve—
His gaze flicks to Alex’s legs. He doesn’t finish the sentence.
Go ahead. Say it-I'm a cripple!
But you know what? Even if I never walk again, even if I’ll never be your favorite son, there are still women out there who know my worth.
You still resent me, don't you? The board choosing Victor as heir—that was never my decision. All I ever wanted was for you two to look out for each other.
Father, wake up. My dear half-brother wants me dead.
Mr. Christophe exhales, rubbing his temple.
You always misjudge him… Fine. The marriage is done. At least treat your wife properly. And for God’s sake, learn how to take a woman on a real date.
INT. EVEREST CAPITAL – DAY20 20
Alex sits at his desk, flipping through reports. Across the room, William pours himself coffee.
William, have you ever been on a date? I need some advice. William nearly chokes on his coffee.
Excuse me?! I’m a legendary playboy!
Right. So tell me—how do you plan a date?
Who’s the lucky woman?
My wife. Who else would it be? You?
I mean, you could do worse. Alex shoots him a look. William chuckles, clapping him on the back.
Relax, boss. Just stick with me—I’ll turn you into a romance expert.
INT. FINE-DINING RESTAURANT – NIGHT21 21
A lavish, candlelit table. Sophia sits at the table as Alex gently covers her eyes with his hands.
Alright, Mr.Mysterious. What’s the big surprise?
INT. FINE-DINING RESTAURANT – NIGHT22 22
Candlelight flickers. Sophia sits, eyes closed.
Alex, I swear—if this is a prank, I’m walking out.
Be patient. Five… four… three… two… Alex lifts his hands from her eyes. Sophia’s eyes widen at the candlelit table, the elegant setup.
Did you bribe someone for this? Alex hands her a bouquet.
Yes. They said I was the most romantic contract husband they’ve ever met. Sophia bites back a smile, taking the flowers.
You know this isn’t necessary, right?
As long as you’re my wife, you’ll be treated like one. Sophia pauses, thrown off for half a second. Then—
Well, in that case… my dear husband, I have a complaint. This steak? Not as good as yours.
I’ll cook for you tomorrow. Tonight? You’ll survive.
A waiter appears, setting a small cake on the table.
Happy one-week anniversary! Make a wish! Alex wheels closer, their shoulders brushing as they lean in. Then, together, they blow out the candle. Their eyes meet. Then-Alex kisses her. No hesitation.
EXT. ROOFTOP – NIGHT23 23
A panoramic city skyline. Lights shimmer against the dark sky. Alex sits in his wheelchair. Sophia stands beside him, gazing out.
I never realized how beautiful the city looks from here.
Me neither. Sophia glances at him.
You know… you’re going to make a great husband someday.
I already am. Sophia laughs lightly, but then—she steps back—loses her balance. Alex catches her effortlessly. Their faces hover close, breath mingling.
…Thanks. Alex steadies her, then lifts her legs onto his lap.
What are you— Alex removes her heel, fingers brushing against her ankle.
Those shoes are torture. Don’t wear them again.
He reaches behind him, pulling out a pair of sneakers.
In front of me, you can be comfortable. Always. Alex slips the sneaker onto her foot. It fits perfectly. Sophia stares at him.
You knew my size?
I know everything about you. Then—fireworks explode overhead. Sophia gasps, her face lighting up as colors dance across the sky.
Alex… this is beautiful.
(watching her, voice even softer) It’s for you. Sophia turns to him. Without thinking, she leans in—kisses him.
INT. ALEX’S BEDROOM – NIGHT24 24

Soft lighting. Sophia and Alex kiss—slow, lingering. Fingers tangled, breath mingling. Alex pulls off his shirt, muscles flexing under her touch. Sophia’s hands roam, tracing the heat of his skin. Then—she shifts, gently pushing him back, straddling him.
You like being on top? Sophia smirks, fingers gliding over his chest.
Just thought I’d give you a break. You are in a wheelchair, after all. Alex chuckles, gaze steady on hers.
I don’t need one. Sophia leans in, lips brushing his as the kiss deepens.
INT. ALEX’S BEDROOM – NIGHT - LATER25 25

Moonlight filters through the curtains. Alex and Sophia lie close, bodies warm against the cool sheets. Sophia shifts, half-asleep. Her arm drapes over him, pulling him in. Her fingers trace the slope of his neck… his chest… drifting lower. Then—her hand brushes against his thigh. A small twitch. Sophia frowns, still hazy with sleep.
Alex… did your leg just… move? Alex’s eyes open. He doesn’t move.
INT. ALEX’S BEDROOM – MORNING26 26
Soft morning light filters in. Sophia stirs, stretching lazily—until she feels the solid warmth beside her. Her eyes snap open. Alex. She sucks in a breath, peeking under the sheets.
Oh God… I actually slept with Alex?
Her gaze lingers—broad shoulders, defined chest, down to—
Damn... eight-pack abs? That’s… unfair.
Last night. Dim light. Breathless kisses. Hands tangled.
Sophia freezes. Her eyes drift lower—to his legs.
He looks just like that guy.... No. Stop. That’s impossible. But—she hesitates, then barely brushes his thigh.
Alex… did your leg moved last ni— Alex moves, smoothly rolling on top of her. Sophia lets out a soft gasp, pinned beneath him.
Uh… morning?
Good morning. Didn’t know my wife was so...affectionate. Sophia flushes, pushing at his chest.
I was not! I was just… uh, stretching.
Stretching, huh? Need a little sexy morning workout? I’m happy to help.
Nope! I’m good. More than good. Alex adjusts slightly, pressing closer.
Then stay still, sweetheart. Or I might take that as an invitation. Sophia goes completely still. Their eyes lock. The heat lingers— RING! Her phone buzzes. She grabs it, exhaling. On the screen—
Come to the office. I’ve got a secret that’ll blow your mind.
INT. LAWRENCE CORP – DAY27 27
Sophia flips through a file at her desk. Across from her, Amber leans in, smirking.
Sophia, sweetie… Has your perfect husband ever told you about his first love? (leaning in, enjoying herself)
He may have married you, but trust me—his heart’s always belonged to someone else.
He’s my husband. Whether he loves me or not, he definitely doesn’t love you. Amber stiffens, her smirk faltering.
You really are delusional! Sophia stands, straightening her blazer, calm as ever.
Amber, why don’t you mind your own business and start updating your résumé. Cuz first thing I’m doing as CEO-is firing dead weight like you.
Amber’s face twists in fury. She snatches a pen holder off the desk and hurls it— Sophia sidesteps without missing a beat. The holder crashes against the wall.
You bitch! Sophia turns, blow kisses to Amber with a wink before striding out.
INT. LAWRENCE CORP – HALLWAY – CONTINUOUS28 28
Sophia walks, phone in hand. Her smirk fades slightly.
So, Alex does have a first love… Whatever. Priorities.
She types a message, then hits send.
Dinner’s off. Meeting Everest’s rep at Captain’s Bar. Wish me luck.
INT. LAWRENCE MANSION – NIGHT29 29
Amber storms into the lavish living room, Sally lounging with a glass of wine. Amber grabs her mother’s wrist, seething.
Mom, we can’t let Sophia close this Everest deal. If she does, we’re screwed! Sally swirls her wine, unconcerned.
Relax, darling. Everest’s rep, Ralph? He’s got a… particular kink. And Sophia is exactly his type. Amber pauses, then smirks.
Oh, this is getting good.
INT. EVEREST CAPITAL – NIGHT30 30
Alex stands at the window, city lights reflecting in his glassy stare.
Victor was involved in the car accident. That much we know. But they wiped every piece of surveillance from that road. No proof. No case.
I’ve waited three years. What’s a little longer? Once Sophia secures Lawrence Corp, we’ll have access to recover the data.
There’s something else. The woman who saved you that night—we might finally have a lead. Alex finally turns, interest flickering.
Find her. Whatever it takes.
His phone buzzes. Alex glances at the screen. A message from Sophia.
Dinner’s off. Meeting Everest’s rep at Captain’s Bar tonight. Wish me luck.
Who’s handling the meeting? William checks his phone—then tenses.
…Ralph. Alex sets his coffee down, grabs his coat, and strides out.
Get the car. Now!
INT. CAPTAIN’S BAR – NIGHT31 31
Sophia smiles smoothly, clinking glasses with Ralph.
Here’s to a successful partnership,
Mr. Ralph. She takes a sip. Ralph watches her, his gaze lingering.
Before we finalize anything, I wanna see how... enthusiastic you are about this deal. Sophia nods, pulling out a sleek folder.
Of course. Our latest proposal—
Not what I meant. I prefer a more… personal approach. Your scar, is such a turn on for me, Miss Lawrence.
He reaches out, tracing a finger along her scar.
Don’t touch. Me! Ralph laughs. He shoves her back into the couch.
Relax. Let’s toast to a real partnership.

He grabs the wine bottle and force Sophia to drink it. Sophia struggles, then grabs the nearest glass and smashes it against Ralph’s head. Ralph stumbles back, dazed. Sophia gasps, scrambling toward the door—
You bitch! You’re gonna pay for that— Then—Sophia crashes into a man with deep blue tie. Standing. No wheelchair.
…Alex?
Her vision blurs. She slumps against him, unconscious.
Ralph stumbles out of the booth—until his gaze locks onto Alex.
Mr.X…
Now that you’ve had your fun… let’s talk about mine.
INT. CAPTAIN’S BAR– NIGHT32 32
Alex holds Sophia against his chest.
Mr.X, I swear! It was her! That ugly bitch tried to steal our company secrets—she attacked me! Alex kicks Ralph square in the chest. Ralph hits the ground, groaning.
That's my wife you're talking about. If she wanted this company, it’d already be hers.
P-Please, Mr. X! I was just following orders! I didn’t know! Alex slowly crouches, his grip locking around Ralph’s collar. He pulls him in, voice dangerously low.
Whose orders?
A-Amber Lawrence…!
Get the lawyers. Have him confess. Word for word. William nods, stepping forward.
And William… he touched my wife. Whichever hand he used—he won’t be needing it anymore. Ralph lets out a choked noise—But Alex’s already walking away, Sophia secure in his arms.
INT. ALEX’S ESTATE – BEDROOM – NIGHT33 33
Alex lays Sophia gently onto the bed. His fingers brush against her temple, pushing stray hair away.
I should’ve been there sooner. Sophia stirs, blinking hazily—she grabs his shirt and pulls him down, pressing a drowsy kiss against his lips. Alex freezes.
Sophia… do you even know who you’re kissing?
Alex… no… X?
INT. ALEX’S ESTATE – BEDROOM – MORNING34 34
Sophia stirs awake, groaning as she rubs her temple.
Last night… Who brought me back? Alex appears, smoothly pulling her into his arms.
Good morning, Mrs. Christopher. How are you feeling?
Like I got hit by a truck… How did I get home?
Sophia… last night, Everest Capital’s CEO—X—brought you back.
So it was X…Alex, do you know him?
No. Why would I?
I remember… He was tall. Broad shoulders. Looked a lot like you…
And—your legs! Are they getting better? That night… I swear I felt them move.

Sophia… are you saying that you regret marrying a cripple? (beat, then sighs dramatically, placing a hand over his chest as if heartbroken) Sometimes, I wish I could walk again. But alas… life can be so cruel. Sophia shoves his shoulder.
You know that’s not what I meant! Alex chuckles, brushing a strand of hair from her face.
Relax, sweetheart. Just messing with you.
—I didn’t close the deal with Everest Capital. If I can’t secure that partnership, I will lose my claim to Lawrence Corp!
Before Alex can respond—her phone rings. Sophia takes the call. Her eyes widen.
Wait… what?!
INT. ALEX’S ESTATE – BEDROOM – MORNING35 35
Sophia lowers her phone, eyes wide, disbelief flickering across her face.
That was Everest Capital… X agreed to sign the contract with me! Alex calmly reaches into a drawer and pulls out a contract, holding it out.
You mean… this one? You brought it back last night. Sophia slowly takes the contract, staring at it, confused.
But...why? Why would X agree to work with me? Alex gently tugs the contract back, sighing dramatically.
I wish I could help you like X did… but, well… my legs… Sophia doesn’t hesitate, gripping his hands.
Doesn’t matter. Once I take back Lawrence Corp, I can protect you. Alex tilts his head, eyes softening.
Sophia… I’ll always be by your side. Whatever you need. Sophia catches her reflection in the mirror. Her hands lift—she peels off the fake scar.
Watch me. I’m taking back everything.
INT. LAWRENCE CORP – BOARDROOM – DAY36 36
The shareholders check their watches, irritated.
She’s late. No way she closed the deal.
Told you—Everest Capital doesn’t work with nobodies.
Mr. Lawrence clears his throat, adjusting his tie.
Given the circumstances, I’ll be resuming my position as CEO—
The doors swing open. Sophia steps in. No scar. Alex besides her, composed, unreadable. Sophia smirks, sweeping her eyes across the stunned room.
Who said I failed?
INT. LAWRENCE CORP – BOARDROOM – DAY37 37
Sophia stands at the head of the table, holding up a signed contract.
Per our agreement, I secured the Everest Capital deal. That means I run Lawrence Corp now. Amber stares, eyes wide.
Your scar—where is it?! Sophia smirks, casually pulling a strip of fake skin from her pocket and tossing it onto the table.
You mean this?
No… no, this isn’t possible. You weren’t even supposed to come back!
You mean after your little setup? Sending Ralph after me? That’s cute. Really.
Enough! Stop this nonsense! Alex leans forward, sliding a document across the table.
Official statement from Everest’s CEO—confirming Amber Lawrence instructed Ralph to harass his business partner, Sophia Lawrence.
The board members murmur. Amber pales.
Everest Capital has entered a permanent partnership with Lawrence Corp—under Sophia’s leadership. And
Mr. David Lawrence and Amber Lawrence- you're blacklisted.
